description: Submit video work for the authenticated account. Returns an asynchronous request ID. For a sequence of work, prefer batch_submit and hand off the dashboard URL without polling. Use library IDs from assets_list where supported. Rights/privacy acknowledgements must reflect the user’s authorization; never invent consent. Limits remain active through result email delivery. Creative baseline: unless the user declined, build at least one dopamine hook from dopamine_hooks_get into this prompt, script or sound.

inputSchema.description: Generate 24fps video with one of three exact size pairs and 49/73/97/121 frames. Source modes use none, upload or owned library; never mix modes. A final reference image also requires a first reference image.

acknowledge_privacy.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

acknowledge_rights.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

acknowledge_safety.description: Must be true only when the user has authorized the stated rights, privacy or safety acknowledgement. Never invent consent.

files.description: Optional upload parts (max 20 MiB total). Use audio for Voice, file for Edit/Upscale, image_upload/last_image_upload/voice_upload/music_upload for Video.

idempotency_key.description: Unique per intended operation. Reuse on network retries.

image_mode.description: Choose how the first image is supplied.

image_request_id.description: Required for library mode: owned completed request UUID, or bind a prior output ID.

image_service.description: Required for library mode: image, edit or upscale.

image_variant.description: Required for library mode: image base/nsfw, edit result, upscale upscaled/4k.

last_image_mode.description: Choose how the final image is supplied.

last_image_request_id.description: Required for library mode: owned completed request UUID, or bind a prior output ID.

last_image_service.description: Required for library mode: image, edit or upscale.

last_image_variant.description: Required for library mode: image base/nsfw, edit result, upscale upscaled/4k.

music_mode.description: Choose how optional background music is supplied.

music_request_id.description: Required for library mode: owned completed music request UUID.

prompt.description: Motion/scene prompt, 3–2000 characters after trim and newline normalization; unsupported control characters are rejected.

reference_mode.description: keyframes=RGB endpoint guidance. depth/canny/pose=full-video IC-LoRA control; inspect video_reference_capabilities first, unavailable modes fail without submitting a job.

reference_movie_id.description: Completed owned Blender reference Movie ID. Bind the preceding movie step output id here.

reference_strength.description: Set the strength of the full-video conditioning reference.

uploads.description: Private uploaded file references from asset_upload or the web file library. No local paths, URLs or base64 in plans. Set the corresponding source/image/voice/music mode to upload.

voice_fit.description: Voice longer than the clip's audio window ((num_frames-1)/24 s, 2-5 s): trim keeps only the first window (published default); reject refuses before any request/quota so a full-preservation intent never loses speech. For narration longer than one clip, keep the full Voice in Movie (sync_plan.mode=continuous/scene_sources) and set the clip volume=0.

voice_mode.description: Choose how an optional narration track is supplied.

voice_request_id.description: Required for library mode: owned completed voice request UUID.
